ad.caption: A Comforting Hug When You Need It Most 🤍
ad.product_title: Custom From Photo - When You Miss Me - Personalized Memorial Faux Fur Shaped Pillow
ad.copy: When I miss Mom, holding this pillow feels like a warm hug I can reach for anytime. 🤍When the house gets quiet and I find myself reaching for the phone to call her, I wrap my arms around this soft heart pillow and feel a little less alone. It’s embroidered with her name and years... If you’re missing someone too, this little hug might help steady your heart. 💌🕯️
